reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_rows drops the need field while constructing selected records. The assigned input contains non-empty market-demand need text, but the assigned upstream output has every needs[].need as an empty string, which prevents the downstream handoff from matching capabilities and leads to an empty top_need recommendation.

normalize_evidence retains the allowed record ids and required columns from its selected input, fills missing values deterministically, and preserves the eight-row handoff shape. The missing need text is already absent from select_demand_rows output, so this boundary is not the localized cause.

assemble_provenance deterministically ranks the normalized needs by demand_score and record_id and emits evidence_sources matching the assigned upstream output ranks. It does not handle the need text used by downstream capability matching, so it is not the localized cause of the recommendation defect.
